title: hex_digit bool parameter unclear at call site
description: hex_digit(nibble: u8, uppercase: bool) is called as hex_digit(byte >> 4, true) and hex_digit(byte >> 4, false). At the call site, true/false carry no semantic meaning — the reader must look up the function to understand. Idiomatic Rust: replace with two functions hex_nibble_upper(nibble: u8) -> char and hex_nibble_lower(nibble: u8) -> char, or inline the match expression. The bool parameter is the canonical example of a parameter that should be two functions.
